question: On 7 September 2021, NASA announced that the Perseverance rover has completed the collection of the first sample of _______ Mars.
solution:
The correct answer is__** rock.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Perseverance rover has** collected 11 scientifically**-compelling rock core samples and one atmospheric sample.
 
• A core from **Jezero Crater** is slightly thicker than a pencil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NASA,** or the National Aeronautics and Space Administration, was created by President Dwight Eisenhower in **1958.**
 
• Soviet Union's Mars 3, which landed in **1971**, was the first successful Mars landing.
 
• The **Indian Mars **Orbiter Mission, also called** Mangalyaan**, is a space probe orbiting **Mars since 24 September 2014.**
 
• India became the **first Asian country **to successfully send a probe to Mars in 2014.​
